name: Kimi ga Nozomu Muv-Luv
source:
Fandisc released for free to members of the age Fan Club, Kimi ga Nozomu Muv-Luv contains two stories:
-Ore ga Hetare de Hetare ga Ore de:
A crossover for [url=/v94]Kimi ga Nozomu Eien[/url] and [url=/v93]Muv-Luv[/url] where the protagonists for each game swap bodies, and wacky hijinks ensue!
-Melvina Maniax
A short story about daily life of the JFK Curry Restoraunt crew.
translation:
免费向age粉丝俱乐部会员发布的粉丝光盘《你所期望的永远×Muv-Luv》包含两个故事：

-我弱你强，你强我弱：
[url=/v94]《你所期望的永远》[/url]与[url=/v93]《Muv-Luv》[/url]的联动故事。两部作品的主人公交换身体，随后发生一连串荒唐闹剧！

-梅尔维娜狂想曲：
关于JFK咖喱餐厅工作人员日常生活的短篇故事。
